svg.aria-label: Two grids of shared-memory banks. Top, a tile of 32 by 32 floats: tile[r][0] for rows 0 to 7 all fall in bank 0, so reading the column takes 32 turns. Bottom, a tile of 32 by 33: tile[r][0] falls in bank r, a diagonal, so the column is read in 1 turn.
svg.text: 1 extra column moves each row of the tile to the next bank.
tile[32][32]: column 0 is all in bank 0
tile[32][33]: tile[r][0] falls in bank r
Banks 0 to 15 of 32, rows 0 to 7 of the tile. Element tile[r][0] sits at word
r × 32 or r × 33; its bank is that word mod 32: always 0, or r.
